name: M4 Sopmod II
source: A happy-go-lucky girl who looks to befriend everybody at school to some success. Ace and Head of the Robotics Club, she could achieve decent grades all-around, but only cares about maths and science. Kind at heart, but impulsive, and lacks a sense of responsibility. She and RO are close friends since she and M4A1 helped her fend off bullies. RO is often acting like her older, wiser sister.
